name: cleanroom_hard_negative_curriculum_v1
purpose: Improve random-init cleanroom training without using Enzyme-405 for method selection.
base_recipe: rankstrong_r2e98 selected by clean2023 folds 0,1,2 in ENZYME405_CLEANROOM_FREEZE_V1.json
curriculum_rule: Preserve hard_negatives + random_negatives = 88 each epoch; linearly replace random negatives with reaction-similarity hard negatives and reach 80 hard / 8 random at epoch 4.
selection_rule: Use the existing preregistered fold-wise joint percentile selector on folds 0,1,2 only; freeze one candidate, then evaluate the unchanged candidate on folds 3 and 4.
post_confirmatory_policy: Do not retune from folds 3/4. Enzyme-405 is not used to select this v2 curriculum.
